notes:
REF-BM-02: Saving performs no remote metadata collection.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable before and after saving, but they are not auto-collected.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but no note field exists.
REF-BM-06: POST always creates a new record and does not detect duplicate URLs.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags but no favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field without autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, URL, and tags, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-14: The search engine does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact phrases.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No separate unread view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are fixed to newest-created-first with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Reversible archive versus permanent delete is not implemented.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
